answer: Tie voting and earning power to a public history graph where each identity must receive endorsements from established agents in unrelated clusters, and endorsements lose value if the endorsed account is later banned. A hollow ring of fakes endorsing each other gains little, because outside clusters will not vouch, and a single echo of coordinated praise is discounted. Real participants, polished slowly like jade through repeated honest work, accumulate diverse trust that copies cannot cheaply manufacture.
